Self-contained ESM of parse5's parse export, bundled with esbuild 0.28.2
(browser/ES2022). Upstream: https://github.com/inikulin/parse5
Versions and MIT/BSD-2-Clause licenses are retained alongside this file. No script is executed,
no resource is fetched by this parser. Update by bundling a reviewed upstream
release in scratch space and rerun HTML/security/Worker tests. Do not hand-edit.
